text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s u-s-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e d-a-t-e s t a-m-p-s and l-e-f-t p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l s-i-m u-l-a-t-i-o-n n-o-t-e-s o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k.
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y c-h-a-i-n-s w-i-t-h f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n a-l i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s and s-t-a-w-e-d d-i-g-i-t-a-l c-u-s-t-o-d-y b-a-c-k-u-p s o-n a u-s-b d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g the i-m-a-g-e-m-e-t-a-d-a t-e-x-t c-o-m-p-l-e-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-r-o-d-u-c-e-d p-e-r-m-i-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s u-s-i-n-g e-m-b-o-s-s-e-d f-o-n-t s a-n-d s-e-q-u-e-n-c-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r s and d-e-p-o-s-i-t-e-d f-a-k-e o-r-i-g-i-n a-l s i-n t h e a-r-c-h-i-v-e f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t.
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s w-i-t-h s-t-a-g-e-d p-h-o-t-o-g-r-a-p-h-y a-l-t-e-r-i-n-g-s and u-p-l-o-a-d-e-d a-l-t e r e d t-a-g s t r e a m s t o w-n b-a-s-e s o f t w-a-r e w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the g-e-o-l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-a d-a-t-a s-c-r-i-b-b-l-e c-h-e-c-k-p-o-i-n-t.
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-i-c-r-o-f-i-n-a-n-c-e-d w-i-l-d-c-a-t-c-h s-a-m-p-l-e s u-s-i-n-g l-a-b-e-l e-d e-n-v-i-r-o-n-m-e-n-t a-l c-o-n-t-a-i-n-e-r s and i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d i-n-t o c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d i-n-g f-a-c-i-l-i-t-y l-o-g-s w-h-i-l-e d-r-o-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-r-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l o-r-i-g-i-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l l-o-g.
